story.vex: Build somewhere convenient. I'll take convenient over defensible any day. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED before it started: the outpost goes where it can actually hold, not just where it looks good on paper. Astro: "One strong factor never offsets a real disqualifier."
